Chapter 1153: Chapter 17: The Secret of the Magic Jade (Please Subscribe)_2

The Chaos Realm cultivated by the Magic Jade Tower itself has not birthed a Great Saint.

A Chaos Great Saint cannot be cultivated just through training,

No matter how powerful the Moyu Tower Master is, he cannot forcefully cultivate a Chaos Great Saint.

If this could be achieved, the Magic Jade Tower would not have fallen into decline.

“The elder is still caught in the time loop…” Lin Yuan tentatively asked.

“Are you asking about the time loop and the matters of reaching the Thirteenth Stage?”

The Moyu Tower Master smiled slightly, “I have indeed left corresponding arrangements elsewhere, which should have been taken by now.”

Upon hearing this, Lin Yuan was not particularly surprised.

His Majesty Xuanhuang left behind the Xuanhuang Universe, and it is estimated that the Moyu Tower Master should’ve left a similar place.

Just because the Xuanhuang Universe has just been born now does not mean that the place left behind by the Moyu Tower Master has also not been born yet; everything depends on conditions of fate.

Whether it’s His Majesty Xuanhuang or the Moyu Tower Master,

Both have been attempting to reach the Thirteenth Stage, caught in time loops, with very limited influence on the outside world.

“However, if all you want is information about reaching the Thirteenth Stage and time loop data, I can provide it to you.”

The Moyu Tower Master smiled slightly.

There is only one treasure and rare weapon, but information can be replicated.

“Thank you, elder.” Lin Yuan felt a joy in his heart.

The Xuanhuang Universe emerged, and the Black Light Great Saint, Dual Origin Great Saint, and many other Chaos Great Saints have rushed here at all costs; what for?

Treasure and rare items within the Xuanhuang Universe?

There is indeed a purpose in this regard, but it is definitely not the main reason.

These Great Saints are more eager to obtain His Majesty Xuanhuang’s views and insights on exploring the Thirteenth Stage and time loops.

So-called treasures and wonders are ultimately just external forces and provide no help in reaching the Thirteenth Stage.

Buzz.

The Moyu Tower Master raised his right hand and pointed at Lin Yuan.

Suddenly, a large amount of information surged into Lin Yuan’s mind.

“Reaching the Thirteenth Stage… time loops…” Lin Yuan’s complexion was thoughtful.

The exploration and knowledge of time loops by the Moyu Tower Master and His Majesty Xuanhuang do not come from thin air but are sourced from elsewhere.

It’s just that any life caught in the time loop while attempting to reach the Thirteenth Stage cannot affect the outside world, let alone convey any information about their own time loop.

Therefore…

If you want to gain accurate exploration knowledge on time loops, you can only get it from those beings who have successfully navigated through the time loop.

And those who have navigated through the time loop? They are the Thirteenth Stage time life.

This is also the reason why many peerless Great Saints traverse the Chaos Void, pursuing the footsteps of Thirteenth Stage time life.

The Moyu Tower Master has traversed various Void Domains, delved into dangerous sites and relics, and once had the fortune to meet a Thirteenth Stage time life and, under its guidance, gained much information on reaching the Thirteenth Stage and time loops.

“Each Chaos Realm consummation’s time loop is different; simply put, you can’t prepare in advance.” The Moyu Tower Master looked at Lin Yuan: “In the future, if you attempt the Thirteenth Stage and get caught in a time loop, it will certainly be something you’ve never experienced before; it will be the most challenging trial for you.”

“For example, if your accomplishments in space are high, then the time loop you fall into will have nothing to do with space.”

“In my view, so-called time loops are entirely formulated based on the aspects you lack the most, your shortest shortcomings.”

The Moyu Tower Master said.

“I see.”

Lin Yuan suddenly understood why the Eye of Myriad Laws had advised him not to pay too much attention to time loops because there’s essentially no need to.

What use is worrying? You can’t prepare in advance anyway.

The various information provided by the Moyu Tower Master also included numerous explanations on this point, even with specific case studies.

For example, in this Chaos Void, a specific Thirteenth Stage time life once faced a time loop when attempting the Thirteenth Stage.

This Thirteenth Stage life was born a spectacle life, one of the most inherently powerful spectacle lives nurtured by the Chaos Void, with immensely rich time bloodline, born with consummate Chaos Realm strength.

It was the indisputable Invincible Great Saint of its era.

And this being, the time loop it fell into was the time loop of an ant.

This means literally, an ant.

Simply put, it descended into the body of an ant; the world where this ant resides had no rules, no extraordinary power, and all the introspections of numerous rules mastered by the peerless Great Saints were entirely useless in this world.

Even the speed of thought became incredibly slow.

To break this time loop, one had to lead the ant tribe to become the strongest group in the world.

Note that ants are the weakest creatures in that world; under the premise of not relying on any extraordinary power or cultivation system, leading the ant tribe to become the strongest group?

This Thirteenth Stage time life almost despaired at the time, ultimately through repeated arrangements and using the pure physical rules of the time loop world, climbed the technology tree, creating one by one ‘high-tech’ weapons from scratch, completely obliterating those life forms whose power and body size were millions of times larger than ants.

And only barely escaped that time loop.

“It’s too difficult.” Lin Yuan couldn’t help but feel it’s tricky.

Are you the most inherently powerful spectacle life nurtured by the Chaos Void? Then let you experience the time loop of the weakest life form, an ant.

Are you solitary? Then let you lead the weakest tribe to become the strongest tribe.

Are you the indisputable Invincible Great Saint? In that time loop, the test isn’t strength; the concept of strength doesn’t exist. It’s purely physical power, where size decides everything, and an ant’s size…

Whatever you’re good at, I’ll strip it away.

“Technology…”

Lin Yuan realized that the key to this Thirteenth Stage time life breaking free from the time loop was technology.

It can be speculated that this Thirteenth Stage time life had never touched on technology, otherwise the time loop wouldn’t have been such a test.

Without exposure to technology, the test is technology; once aware of technology, the time loop test will be another kind.

“No wonder that throughout history in the Chaos Void, numerous consummate Chaos Realms have been birthed, but few successfully crossed into the Thirteenth Stage…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, if the time loop is really so targeted, even for peerless Great Saints, the possibility of crossing it is almost none.

“I wonder what time loop I’ll face when I attempt the Thirteenth Stage in the future?”

Lin Yuan silently pondered; anyway, it certainly won’t be anything he currently has mastery over.

…

“Elder, I am now inside the Xuanhuang Universe…”

Lin Yuan said, wanting to get some information about His Majesty Xuanhuang from the Moyu Tower Master.

Although the time loop can’t be prepared for in advance, the exploration knowledge provided by the Moyu Tower Master helped Lin Yuan significantly.

Since it can’t be prevented, he should try to comprehensively understand every aspect of abilities.

Thus, even in future time loops, facing tests he has never encountered before, knowing multiple paths may lead to more possibilities of crossing.

Hence, Lin Yuan is also keenly seeking exploration knowledge left by His Majesty Xuanhuang regarding time loops.

“Xuanhuang huh…”

The Moyu Tower Master pondered for a while: “I don’t know much about him, just that he attempts the Thirteenth Stage not for great freedom but to resurrect his former dao companion.”

“To resurrect a former dao companion?”

Lin Yuan was slightly stunned; Thirteenth Stage time lives can see through the future and past timelines and can follow the time line to resurrect any past-existing beings, including Twelve Stage lives liberated from the constraints of the time river.

“That’s all I know.”

The Moyu Tower Master shook his head slightly, “But I heard that before attempting the Thirteenth Stage, he entered some dimensional rift and immediately prepared for the Thirteenth Stage after returning, likely experiencing something in the dimensional rift.”

“So that’s the case.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

A dimensional rift is a gap area separating different dimensional realms.

And the dimensional realm that can be separated from the Chaos Void is probably not weaker than the Chaos Void itself; between them, the dimensional rift is very likely to birth some terrifying existences.
